# Feature: Analytics Integration

## Overview
Implement comprehensive analytics tracking across the marketing website to measure user behavior, conversion rates, and SEO performance.

## User Stories

1. Event Tracking
   - As a marketing manager
   - I want to track user interactions
   - So that I can understand user behavior

2. Conversion Tracking
   - As a marketing manager
   - I want to track conversion funnels
   - So that I can optimize sign-up rates

3. Custom Reporting
   - As an analytics user
   - I want to create custom reports
   - So that I can track specific metrics

4. Goal Management
   - As a marketing manager
   - I want to set up and track goals
   - So that I can measure success

5. A/B Testing
   - As a growth manager
   - I want to run A/B tests
   - So that I can optimize conversions

## Technical Tasks
- [ ] Implement Google Analytics 4
- [ ] Create custom event tracking
- [ ] Build conversion funnels
- [ ] Implement goal tracking
- [ ] Create A/B testing framework
- [ ] Add heat mapping
- [ ] Implement user flow tracking
- [ ] Create custom dashboards
- [ ] Add data visualization
- [ ] Implement privacy controls

## Acceptance Criteria
- Events track accurately
- Conversions properly attributed
- Custom reports generate correctly
- Goals track reliably
- A/B tests work properly
- Privacy compliance maintained
- Data exports available
- Real-time tracking works

## Technical Notes
- Use tag management system
- Implement proper consent
- Use background processing
- Cache report data
- Follow GDPR requirements
- Implement proper sampling

## Estimate
- Story Points: 8
- Time Estimate: 1 week

## Dependencies
- Technical SEO feature
- Performance Optimization feature
